purpose: Decompose the apparent all-calendar nuclear-window association in the open POSS-I S0 cohort into observation-schedule selection and candidate-rate conditional on actual observing opportunity, then stress-test the residual rate against calendar, sky-footprint, exposure/WCS, lunar and geomagnetic covariates.

central_forensic_gate.statement: If every observed POSS-I night contains at least one S0 candidate, then the all-calendar ANY_CANDIDATE binary variable is identical to PALOMAR_OBSERVED_NIGHT. In that case the all-calendar Fisher odds ratio is exactly a telescope-schedule association, not a candidate-rate association.
required_assertions: all 312 analyzed observed nights have candidate_count > 0
binary 2x2 table for ANY_CANDIDATE equals binary 2x2 table for PALOMAR_OBSERVED_NIGHT for each calendar arm
odds ratios and Fisher p-values are identical to numerical precision
central_forensic_gate.interpretation_if_passed: The binary OR cannot be attributed to excess transient-like candidates; it is generated by differential overlap between the nuclear-window calendar and the Palomar observing schedule.

conditional_rate_ladder.role: Tests candidate rate given actual observation opportunity before nuisance adjustment.
Final decomposition model; Kp/Ap are nuisance/specificity covariates, not mechanistic attribution.

geomagnetic.official_status: IAGA-endorsed Kp; definitive values required for 1949-1957 window

lunar.authority: U.S. Naval Observatory Astronomical Applications Department
lunar.service: Complete Sun and Moon Data for One Day API
lunar.sampling_time: 12:00 UTC proxy for each POSS-I plate date because historical FITS headers provide date/exposure but not a reliable exposure start time in this reconstruction

palomar_coordinates.source_note: Palomar RMS almanac reports longitude 7h47m27s W, latitude +33d21.4m.

lunar.forbidden_inference: Lunar illumination fraction alone is not Moon altitude, cloud, sky brightness or exact illumination during the exposure.

human_layer_specificity_control.role: Independent phenotype specificity layer only; not pooled into the photographic likelihood.
frozen_findings: STARLIKE_WITNESS exists on both nuclear and non-nuclear dates
retrospective NUFORC monthly sensitivity did not show a positive nuclear association
official exact-date Blue Book matched-control rate remains pending
human_layer_specificity_control.forbidden_use: Do not promote a POSS-I nuclear association because a human STARLIKE report exists on a nuclear date.

admission_rule.schedule_confounded_binary_claim: ADMIT only if ANY_CANDIDATE table exactly equals OBSERVED_NIGHT table.
admission_rule.residual_positive_nuclear_rate_claim: ADMIT only if M6 IRR>1, two-sided p<0.05, 95% CI excludes 1, and the same positive direction survives all three frozen calendar arms plus schedule-preserving circular-shift control.
